name: stationary scores by repeated propagation
mechanism: give every node a score, repeatedly replace each node's score by a damped sum of the scores flowing in along its edges, and stop when scores no longer change; the fixed point is the stationary distribution of a random walk

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'PageRank' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Network theory:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Hyperlink-Induced Topic Search (HITS) (also known as Hubs and authorities)':

requires: a damping/teleport rule for dead ends (policy)
fails_when: dangling nodes and disconnected parts need the teleport
convergence rate depends on the spectral gap
